title: The ISS Needs An $843 Million Deorbit Vehicle
hook: NASA will spend $843 million to bring the ISS down.
closing: Ending the station safely matters to everyone living beneath its final path.
question: Should the ISS be replaced?

segments.say: The ISS has hosted people continuously for 24 years, making its planned ending feel almost unthinkable.
NASA spends $3 billion annually on the ISS, so keeping it aloft has a continuing cost.
The ISS deorbit vehicle costs $843 million because the station cannot be left to fall uncontrolled.
